gibuu_ch.label: GiBUU 2019 on CH, under MP3-C's label: 'B3 (sampling closure) failed on hydrogen; a post-hoc bias check of its premise passed at <= 0.1 sigma_c'
gibuu_ch.weight: perweight x r(E_nu) / M x 1e-38 (M = number of runs), C12 x 12/13 and H x 1/13 (mp3c_build.py:4-9, :57); E_nu <= 20 GeV only (KNOWN_ISSUES 82); frozen r(E) (not the post-hoc alternative)
gibuu_ch.struck_nucleon: the single perweight-0 nucleon row (ID 1; charge +1 proton, 0 neutron); if an event has not exactly one, the CVUniverse default mass (1.5 M_n + M_p)/2.5. UNSETTLED: to be verified on the files in S2 preflight (2p2h events)

tune_v1.rows: the 32,849,103 s5p MCgen rows via the admitted S1 dump (phase1/mp2/s1_receipt.json sha256 d240b41a...), global MCgen row index i
tune_v1.training_rows: mc_targetZ in {1, 6} (30,028,386 C + 1,632,529 H), inside the fine grid and inside G's E_nu support
tune_v1.particles: mc_FSPart* rotated by RotateX(-0.05887) into the MAT beam frame (MP-5 section 1)

targets.rule: train only on C and H rows on both sides: Tune v1 C+H rows against G on CH (C12 and free-proton events at 12/13 : 1/13 per nucleon). The target is never a feature.
targets.other_nuclei: Tune v1 rows with mc_targetZ not in {1, 6} (1,188,188 rows: O, N, Al, Si, Cl, Ti, Z = 0) keep the A7 hybrid weight r_h at Tune v1's composition. Limitation, stated in every readout.
targets.justification: S0's sample had 3.8% non-carbon rows that no C12 or CH generator sample contains; any such row is a target-identity signal the classifier can learn. Restricting to C+H on both sides leaves only model differences on a common target.

conventions.rule: every generator event is put in the analysis convention before any feature is computed (MP-5 sections 1-3): beam-axis theta, struck-nucleon W, NaN W dropped

rotation.pool: MP-5's nu-direction pool: /pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/measurement-paper/phase1/mp5/run/pool/pool_b0..5.npy (sha256 in mp5_tune.json direction_pool), nu direction in the MAT frame with w_truth, by E_nu bin
rotation.draw: as mp5_declaration.json 'draw': per event in bin b, k = searchsorted(cdf_b, u, 'right') clipped, cdf over the w_truth of the bin's pool rows in pool order
rotation.rng: numpy default_rng(seed_g), one uniform per generator event in the declared file order (C12 main, C12 supplement, H main, H supplement; entries in file order, CC or not)
rotation.operation: Rodrigues rotation R(n) with R z = n (mp5_declaration.json 'rotation'), applied to the lepton AND every final-state particle (the generator nu is along +z; asserted per event, GiBUU included)

conventions.pt_ppar: pT = hypot((R p_mu)_x, (R p_mu)_y), p_par = (R p_mu)_z, GeV; phase-space decision u2d.in_truth_phase_space on them
conventions.W: CVUniverse::GetTrueExperimentersW (gen_to_xsec5d.w_struck, gen_to_xsec5d.py:123-131) with theta from the beam axis and M by struck nucleon (2112: 939.56536, 2212: 938.272013, else (1.5 M_n + M_p)/2.5 MeV); NaN where W^2 < 0: the event is outside the grid, exactly as Tune v1's NaN-W rows (MCgen -9999)
conventions.E_avail: MAT GetEAvailableTrue (CVUniverse.h:361-374) over the harmonized final-state list, for both sides (S1 C3 shows it reproduces MC_eavail bitwise for Tune v1)
conventions.harmonized_products: for V2 and the reference hybrid, each G's fine 5D CH product is rebuilt from these harmonized events with its frozen normalization (x = hist(w)/dV; sumw2 likewise)

particles.gibuu_id_map: GiBUU ID+charge to PDG: 1 -> 2212/2112, 101 -> 211/111/-211, 102 -> 221, 110/111 -> K, 32 -> 3122, 33 -> Sigma by charge, negative IDs -> antiparticles; anything else -> 'other'. UNSETTLED until S2 preflight lists the IDs present
particles.de_excitation: no generator emits nuclear de-excitation photons on C as far as checked; photons below 10 MeV are dropped from every feature. UNSETTLED for GiBUU and GENIE 2.12 (S2 preflight reports the photon spectrum per generator)

features.definitions: sum_em_E = sum of pi0 E and gamma E (above thresholds); E_other = sum of E of 'other' species; leading = highest KE above threshold, cos in the beam frame, NaN when absent (LightGBM missing)
features.fallback_grounds: the simulated response MINERvA applies is conditional on the per-species visible energy (proton, meson, EM, other: the MP-1 species bands, BINDING-PHASE1 D1) and on the neutron energy; leading-particle angles and multiplicities enter mainly through tracking and containment. F_fallback keeps the response-relevant species energy split and drops the rest. One fallback only, used only if F_primary fails V1-V4 for that G, and only before S3.

model.validation: 10% of each fold's training rows (seeded), weighted binary logloss
model.class_weights: each class sums to half its split's row count (as S0)
model.tune_training_subsample: per model at most 4,000,000 Tune rows drawn uniformly from its training rows (seed per model); prediction on ALL rows of the held-out fold
model.probability_clip: p clipped to [1e-9, 1 - 1e-9] for numerics only; no weight cap
model.weight_cap: NONE. A cap would bias the null and, set at or below 50, would satisfy V4's maximum-weight bound by construction. V4 is evaluated on uncapped weights.
model.normalisation: w_G = c x p/(1-p); c fixed so that the in-grid C+H content sum(w_truth w_G) equals that under the reference hybrid H_CH,an (the generator's rate as the hybrid imposes it)

folds.code_facts: r_h is computed once over all MCgen rows (nd-unfolding/s5p_nullexp.py:299) and every experiment draws its own A/B split, half_mask(n, split_key_for(seed)) (s5p_nullexp.py:318-320; s5c_pseudo.py:44-51, :278-281). A fold structure cannot be nested in every experiment's split at once.
folds.declared: two-level: half h(i) = s5c_pseudo.half_mask(n, s5c_pseudo.split_key_for(ASIMOV_SEED)); within each half, fold f(i) = (splitmix64(i XOR fold_key_k) >> 1) mod 5 (the half_mask mixer, bits above the parity bit). Model (k, h, f) is trained on Tune rows of half h, folds != f, and on G events of G-fold != f; it predicts Tune rows of half h, fold f. G events: G-fold = splitmix64(j XOR (fold_key_k + 1)) mod 5 over the generator event index j.
folds.consequence: for the S3 Asimov split the weights are nested (no row is weighted by a model trained on it, and no pseudo-data-source row by a model trained on the unfolding half). For S4's per-experiment splits they are cross-fitted only. UNSETTLED for S4 (director).

seeds.replica_role: Delta_hyb primary = mean over the K replicas; V5 = their spread

support.enu: training restricted to G's E_nu support: GENIE and NuWro main+supplement 0-100 GeV (NuWro 0.5-100), GiBUU 0-20 GeV. Tune rows outside keep the A7 hybrid r_h; their in-grid w_truth share per J cell is reported
support.fine_cells: G-only fine cells: Tune C+H has < 20 rows (FINE_N_MIN, s5p_truths.py:151) while G has rate. Event weights cannot populate them; that rate is NOT redistributed. Reported per G: fraction of in-grid G rate, and per J cell in sigma_c units (MP3-B reading (a)). Tune-only cells: the classifier's w there is reported (expected ~ 0 if G is empty)
support.feature_space: share of G held-out events with p > 0.99 and of Tune rows carrying w > 50 <w>, and the J cells they fall in (report)
support.no_anchoring: no per-cell renormalisation of w_G (that would make V2 trivial); only the global c

gates.V1: held-out two-sample test: pooled held-out Tune rows (at most 4,000,000, seed v1_split_seed, weighted w_truth x w_G) vs G's held-out events; a fresh classifier (model.params) on 50%, AUC on 50%; pass if AUC <= AUC(G vs G split) + 0.005, the control trained on G halves of the same sizes with n_estimators FIXED to the V1 classifier's best iteration (capacity-matched; S0's controls stopped at 1-19 iterations)
gates.V2: closure of the fine 5D and J marginals of the reweighted Tune C+H truth against G's harmonized CH product within the summed sumw2: chi2/ndf <= 1.5 over fine cells with >= 20 entries on both sides, and no J cell beyond 3 sigma
gates.V3: closure of the V3_heldout distributions (reweighted Tune C+H vs G, held-out rows). The draft gives NO threshold. PROPOSED, flagged: as V2 (chi2/ndf <= 1.5, no bin beyond 3 sigma)
gates.V4: Kish ESS of w_truth x w_G over the Tune C+H in-grid rows >= 0.3 N, N = the row count; and max(w_G)/<w_G>_{w_truth} <= 50. Uncapped. ESS/ESS(w_truth) also reported
gates.V5: per J cell, SD over the K replicas of Delta_hyb <= 0.2 |mean Delta_hyb| or <= 0.1 delta_fine(c), delta_fine = |delta_M1| of the frozen m1_shift declaration (s5p_joint.py:227-234); evaluated at S3
gates.order: V1-V4 at S2 on F_primary; on failure, F_fallback (once, before S3); failure again -> 'not established' for that G, A7's hybrid result stands. V5 at S3: failure -> 'not established'. No tuning after any S3 or S4 output.
gates.threshold_changes: none: V1, V2, V4, V5 as drafted in PLAN.md section 3.3; V3's threshold is new and flagged

replay.asimov: per G: noise-free unfolded J cells (s5p_nullexp --expectation --no-nuisance, s5p_nullexp.py:31-35, :240-241) at split_key_for(ASIMOV_SEED), the frozen estimator configuration, once with the event-level null (each replica k) and once with each reference hybrid

references.H_CH,an (primary): fine_ratio (s5p_truths.py:165-205) from G's harmonized CH product: isolates hybridization from target and convention
references.H_A7 (secondary): the frozen A7 hybrid r_h: the total change of the null

replay.delta_hyb: Delta_hyb(G, c) = J_event(c) - J_hyb(c), mean over replicas; readings over sigma_c (MP3-B (a), (b), (c)) and Delta^T W^-1 Delta
replay.rule: the kappa-scan/MP3-B replay: each null ensemble F of G shifted to F + Delta_hyb (with every declared shift variant; claim p = the largest), s5p_joint.statistics (s5p_joint.py:147), s5p_inference.mc_pvalue (:52), then Holm with determinacy (s5p_inference.py:127) over the frozen ten-test family, with established G's replaced and the others frozen; also at kappa = 3. As in mp3b_eval.py:166-169 and publication/kappa/RECORD-20261008-kappa-breakdown.md
replay.status: report only, beside A7, never a re-grade (D6); identity control first: Delta_hyb = 0 must return A7's decisions exactly

cost_estimate_cpu_node_h.unit: 17 ns per training row-iteration at 64 threads (S0); prediction 1.9 us per row per model at 64 threads (S0: 2.43 s for 1.30M)
cost_estimate_cpu_node_h.S2_fits: 4 G x 5 replicas x 2 halves x 5 folds = 200 models on <= 4M Tune + <= 2M G rows (~1,500 iterations, ~150 s each) plus prediction of ~3M rows each: ~0.7-1.2 node-h packed (64 threads per process, 4 per node)
cost_estimate_cpu_node_h.S2_fallback_if_used: up to the same again for the affected G
cost_estimate_cpu_node_h.S3: 4 G x (5 + 2) Asimov unfolds at 0.03-0.06 (M, W2A-REPORT-20261006.md:29) = 0.8-1.7, replay ~1 core-h
cost_estimate_cpu_node_h.total_S2_S3: ~2-3.5 CPU node-h (PLAN 3.4 says S2 <= 1, S3 1-2: the nested two-level folds roughly double the fits)
cost_estimate_cpu_node_h.S4: ~110-225 CPU node-h, only inside the combined campaign of PLAN section 6, under its own contract and grant; the S4 nesting question (folds) must be settled first

open_caveats: 50-100 GeV supplements: included in training for GENIE and NuWro at their constant r; GiBUU has nothing above 20 GeV; Tune rows above each G's range keep r_h
particle harmonization: pseudo-particles, remnants, de-excitation photons, GiBUU ID map and thresholds are declared, not yet verified on all four samples (S2 preflight lists them, report only)
split-control early stop (S0): addressed in V1 by capacity matching; S0's controls are themselves weak
S4 fold nesting across per-experiment splits
V3 threshold absent in the draft
V4's N read as the row count (the strict reading)
